title: OpenCode Studio Manifest
description: Minimal OSC manifest for focused OpenCode Studio packages. Package name, binaries, and exports remain in package.json.

id.description: Short domain identifier (e.g. cad, media, pcb).

contractVersion.description: OSC contract version this Studio targets.

plugin.description: Package export specifier for the OpenCode plugin (bare package registration or subpath such as ./server).

skill.description: Package-relative path to the skill directory.
